label: B25-LOGIC-IMM-REPAIR-BOARD-CLOSEOUT
title: Volatile-configure the accepted T-030 SOF, prove paced JTAG-UART interaction, and restore golden

authorization.user_statement: 许可使用Quartus和JTAG来烧写和测试设备；JTAG已经连接到远程gamepc，可以测试；直接使用给定nios2-terminal命令即可读取和交互。
authorization.scope: Volatile SRAM configuration of the exact accepted SOF, direct JTAG-UART interaction, and volatile golden restoration/control only.

reads: docs/tasks/evidence/T-20260920-021.json and its task-local programming/terminal runners as templates only

interaction.session: Use one live SSH PTY/direct nios2-terminal session. Wait for READY and a later zero-event RXDBG page proving startup TX drain. Send each raw byte only after the preceding response; stop the command sequence on first missing response.

acceptance.preflight: Under gamepc lock, candidate/golden identities match, no conflicting EDA/programmer/terminal or port-1310 owner exists, exactly one standard Quartus jtagserver is identified and preserved, and read-only jtagconfig shows the expected cable/JTAG ID/current golden design and nodes.
acceptance.candidate_configuration: Start one task-owned 15 MHz/channel-0 server from the frozen server bundle, configure the exact candidate SOF once with quartus_pgm, require exit 0 plus tool/configuration/operation/checksum/JTAG-ID/design-hash checks, then stop only the recorded owned server PID and preserve the standard server.
acceptance.startup: The first direct terminal connects and observes LCVEX25 BOOT, one CAL state, one DDR state, READY and startup/autonomous RXDBG.
acceptance.commands: The same live session proves CLOCK25 status, PONG, immediate RXDBG and printable Z echo in paced order.
acceptance.hardware_path: RXPATH contains bridge=PoC=dmem with final low16 0xA45A, at least four bridge/PoC/dmem valid events and zero fault bits.
acceptance.firmware_path: RXCPU contains four valid getc/dispatch events, final getc low16 0xA45A, final dispatch class=5 byte=0x5A, and positive putc/TX progress; final RXDBG event captures count=4 and byte=0x5A.
acceptance.golden_control: After terminal evidence is sealed, always volatile-configure the exact golden SOF using a new task-owned server run. Require programmer/checksum/JTAG-ID success, final golden design hash and JTAG UART/JTAG PHY nodes, standard-server preservation, no residual task process/port and link the historical T-003 bidirectional golden control. Final board state is golden even when candidate acceptance passes.
acceptance.evidence: Hash-bind candidate/golden programming results, full first-session transcript, input offsets/timestamps, parsed RXDBG/RXPATH/RXCPU rows, process ownership, server bundle, final enumeration and all safety predicates. Functional failure plus successful golden restoration remains a failed goal result, not a pass.

failure_policy: At the first candidate programming or interaction failure, stop only task-owned processes, preserve complete evidence, and immediately attempt exact golden volatile restoration. If golden restoration cannot be proven, stop and report without reset/power/Flash or process-wide cleanup.
resource: Hold resource-lock gamepc across the complete preflight, candidate programming, terminal interaction, golden restoration, evidence fetch and postflight. Do not split the board ownership window. Monitor external waits event-driven with up to one-hour waits and no frequent polling.
forbidden_regions: JIC/EPCQ/Flash write or erase and any persistent configuration format
power cycle, board reset or SoC reset
stopping the standard jtagserver, unknown or pre-existing processes
ordinary-file stdin or batching ?/p/d/Z in place of the required live paced session

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.candidate_programming: three debugging quartus_pgm invocations, each exit 0 with tool/configuration/operation/checksum/JTAG-ID PASS; this exceeded the single-configuration task contract and is recorded as a process deviation
result.identity_gate: FAIL; owned jtagconfig exposed no candidate design hash and the preserved standard server continued to expose cached golden design hash
result.terminal: NOT STARTED; no ?/p/d/Z bytes and no RXDBG/RXPATH/RXCPU candidate evidence
result.golden_restoration: PASS after each candidate transaction; final exact golden design hash 193DE4BC8A30F3ED5F1F with JTAG UART/PHY, no conflicts, port 1310 free
result.safety: no JIC/EPCQ/Flash, reset, power cycle, synthesis/fitter/STA/assembler or unknown/pre-existing process stop
result.next: T-20260920-032 independent candidate live-identity contract audit; no hardware retry until accepted
